subject: "Free" update.
author: kevlar0
body:
The new update refinements seem to be all for offline play and for newcomers to the game (apart for the in-game store for the PS3).

All I can say is they haven't taken a blind bit of notice to the players who have been playing the game since release, who have commented about many game killing aspects (ranked racing, takedowns, Fog on-off option and countless others), and i'm also guessing that this a compulsary download if you want to play online. looks like its tough titties for those of us who were expecting to get at least some of the game fixing updates we have been complaining about since the game came out.

Criterion, not listening, not caring, not gonna do a damn thing for its old school hardcore fanbase, thanks for kcuf all.

And to all you Paradise noobs, bite me.

 

He's not the messiah, he's a very naughty boy.
